meta.title: Model Translator
meta.description: Auto-translate model output and thinking (reasoning) to any language. Supports Bing, Google, and model-based translation.

settings.title: Model Translator Settings
settings.subtitle: Automatically translates model output and thinking (reasoning) during streaming. If translation fails, the original text is shown.
settings.providerHintFree: Free translation API — no model inference, text is sent to the translation service.
settings.providerHintAuto: Follow the current conversation's model (no separate model pick).
settings.providerHintModel: Translate with a specific dsh-loaded model. Pick one below.
settings.modelHintModel: Pick a dsh-loaded model for translation. It uses that model's own provider route.
settings.modelLoadFailed: Could not load the model list.
settings.targetLanguageHint: Use "Auto" to follow the interface language, or select a specific language.
settings.timeoutMsHint: Per translation request, 100–60000 ms. Raise it for model routes — a 4000-char segment often exceeds 10s and the block is then flushed untranslated.
settings.maxTextCharsHint: Longer blocks are split into segments of this size, translated, and joined back. Raise for fewer calls, lower for providers with small request limits.
settings.unavailable: Settings are not available. Please ensure the plugin is properly configured.
settings.formUnavailable: Configuration form is not available. Edit the bundle's cordis.patch.yml directly.
